verdict.rationale: Vercel's CLI docs say it can 'replicate your deployment environment locally' (vercel-docs-47), and environment management covers a distinct 'local' environment with its own variables (vercel-docs-23). eve agent apps are also documented to run 'locally or on Vercel' (vercel-docs-42). Beyond that single CLI mention, nothing documents a local dev server, how closely it matches production runtimes (functions, middleware, Fluid compute), or its testing workflow. Missing for 10: a documented local dev/simulator command with details, evidence of runtime parity for functions/middleware/edge, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
